note: Hand-built, judged by reading the papers, frozen once measured. Queries are phrased the way someone who has NOT read the paper would ask; none reuses a title or an abstract sentence, because that measures string overlap surviving an encoder rather than retrieval. An entry with an empty expected_papers is a near-miss probe: in-domain, answered by no paper in the corpus, scored separately so it reports whether a low top score is a usable 'I don't know' signal for Phase 4.
